summary: Frontend-only test of the Boat Budget year ledgers (budget per year, year selector, lock/unlock of past years, Start <year> budget, change history, Excel Year/Last change) as Pro skipper test_session_pro_1 (TEST_Kia Ora) at 1920 and 390px. To test past years, Playwright moved the browser clock to 1 Feb 2027 (an init script that shifts Date), so 2026 became a past year. Almost everything PASSES. One bug: in a locked year, 'Edit link' still opens the web link dialog, and Save silently does nothing. Results: (1) The select defaults to 2026 and lists '2027', '2026 (this year)', plus '2028 / 2027 (this year) / 2026' when the clock is 2027, newest first. The 12 old rows got year 2026 and that was synced (GET /api/me/boat shows year 2026). (2) Adding a row puts it in the selected year with 'Added to the 2026 budget'. Editing cost 120->150, Date paid, Description and Product adds history entries, newest first, e.g. 'Cost 120 to 150, Nov 4, 2026'. These persist. (3) The footer 'Total 2026' and the cards (all years / this year / last year / previous year) sum each year's rows correctly. (4) Past year 2026 with the clock in 2027: the banner reads '2026 is a past year, so it's locked...' with Unlock to correct. Cost has readonly set, so typing did not change it. The date input and the delete button are disabled (a forced click did not delete). The add form and the start button are hidden. Product is readonly. The row tone is orange. After Unlock, budget-unlocked-note shows, the add form shows, and cost 150->175 and a web link add history entries. (5) The 2027 empty view shows 'Start 2027 budget from 2026'. It copied 13 rows (label/product/cost kept, date cleared, url cleared for rows copied before the link was added, history 'Copied from the 2026 budget'). Toast: '13 rows copied ... 2026 is unchanged'. GET /api/me/boat confirmed the 2026 rows kept year/cost/paid. 2028 offers 'Start 2028 budget from 2027'. (6) The Excel 'This list' export has Year and Last change columns, sorted by year. (7) Regression passes: currency USD->NZD shows NZ$150.00; delete + Undo restores the row; the two-step delete list goes first->certain->Keep Budget; AI comments Refresh returned new text in about 15s; the web link opens through opening-store; no horizontal overflow at 390px (scrollWidth 390).

ui_bugs.issue: In a locked past year, tapping the web link opens opening-store, and its 'Edit link' button opens the budget-url dialog. Save closes the dialog but the change is silently dropped, because update() returns early when locked. The spec says the link can be opened but not edited. Fix: pass locked and hide opening-store-edit-btn when locked, or check `if (!locked && guard())` in onEdit.

issues: budget-year-select is !w-28, so '2026 (this year)' is cut to '2026 (thi' at both 1920 and 390px. Widen it (e.g. w-40) or use a shorter label.
Disabled delete X buttons and readonly cells look exactly like active ones (no opacity or cursor change). Add disabled:opacity-40 to the delete button and a muted style to readonly cells.
Date paid entries show raw ISO, e.g. 'Date paid (blank) to 2026-03-10', while the table uses dd/mm/yy. Format with shortDate.

action_items: Do not allow Edit link from opening-store while the year is locked (BudgetTable.jsx line ~101 onEdit; also hide the Edit link button when locked).
Widen budget-year-select so '(this year)' is not cut off.
Give locked rows a visual disabled state (delete button opacity, readonly cells).

Optional: format Date paid values in the history with shortDate. Note that 'Total cost (all years)' and 'this year so far' include copied planned costs that are not paid yet. Consider whether 'so far' should count only rows with Date Paid, or rename the card.
critical_code_review_comments: BudgetTable: the unlocked state is component-local and stays on when switching years (unlock 2026 -> view 2027 -> back to 2026 is still unlocked until a reload). This is acceptable, but consider re-locking on year change.

Changing Date paid to another year does not move the row's ledger year (item.year is fixed). This is by design, but rows cannot be moved between years, and a past year only shows in the selector if it already has rows. A user can never open an empty past year to back-fill it.
copyYear/add use Date.now() ids. That is fine, but Start-year ids (start+n) could collide with a row added in the same ms (very unlikely).

Sync merge (backend sync_merge.py) trusts client timestamps. A device with its clock ahead (seen when testing with a shifted clock) stamps list_ts in the future, and later deletes from correctly-clocked devices are reverted by the merge. This already existed before this change, but past/future-year testing with a shifted clock triggers it.
seed_data_creation: None kept. A TEST_Mainsail repair row and 13 copied 2027 rows were created during testing. Because they were made with the browser clock shifted to 2027, their ts and list_ts.boatBudget were in the future, so UI deletes made with the real clock were reverted by sync_merge. They were removed with a targeted $pull by their ids on user_boats {owner_id:'test-user-pro', boat_id:'main'}, and list_ts.boatBudget/updated_at were reset to now. Afterwards a real-clock add/delete persisted correctly. The 12 original budget rows remain and now carry year 2026 (the expected migration). budget_notes was replaced by one AI Refresh (regression test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pro test_session_pro_1, boat TEST_Kia Ora, Boat Budget via list-selector -> list-option-boatBudget. To test past years, add page.add_init_script(path='/tmp/bud/shift.js'), which shifts Date to 2027-02-01 (page.clock.install hung the page). WARNING: edits made with a shifted clock stamp future ts/list_ts, so real-clock deletes get reverted. Clean up with the shifted clock moved later still, or with a targeted Mongo fix of only the rows you created plus a list_ts reset. /tmp/bud/dump.py prints budget rows (year, cost, paid, history). Testids: budget-year-select, budget-locked-banner, budget-unlock-btn, budget-unlocked-note, budget-start-year-btn, budget-history-{id}, budget-total-all, excel export: *-export-excel-btn -> excel-export-one-btn.
rca of the issue: Locked Edit link: BudgetTable passes onEdit={() => { ...; if (guard()) setLinkFor(it); }} to OpeningStore without checking locked. The TextDialog then opens, and saveLink calls update(), which returns early when locked, yet setLinkFor(null) still closes the dialog. The user sees an apparently successful save that changed nothing. Repro: set the clock to 2027, view 2026 (locked), expand a row with a url, tap Web link, then Edit link, change the url, Save: the url is unchanged.
